PluginReport.description: A report of one plugin on a submitted attempt, an assignment or a course, for the staff who may see it.

key.description: The name the plugin gave this report: it keeps one report per key on a subject.

plugin_id.description: The id the plugin gave in its manifest.

PluginSettings.description:
The settings of a plugin as an administrator configured them, with the defaults of its manifest
where nothing was set. A setting with neither is not in `values`.

values.description:
Setting key to value: a string, a number, a boolean or a list. Secrets are in clear: the
plugin is who they were entered for.

PluginSubmission.description:
A submitted attempt as a plugin with `submissions:read` sees it: which work, whose, and what it
says. No draft, no score and no grade.

content.description:
A block document for a `text` assignment, `{"answers": {...}}` for a quiz or a form,
`{"files": [...], "comment"?}` for a file.

id.description: The id the `submission.submitted` event carries as `submission_id`.

PutReportRequest.description:
What a plugin says about a submitted attempt, an assignment or a course. It replaces the plugin's
earlier report on the subject under the same key.

data.description: What a program may want: a JSON object of at most 16 KiB.

summary.description: One line for people to read, 1 to 500 characters.

SendMailRequest.description:
One call to send plain-text mail in the institution's name (ADR-0085). The plugin never sees an
address. The footer, the opt-out link and the sender are added by the core.

dedupe_key.description:
At most 100 characters. The same plugin, key and person is accepted once in 30 days, so a
plugin that retries should always send one.

kind.description:
A slug of at most 40 characters (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`): groups mails for opt-out and
statistics. A person opts out per plugin and kind.

link_path.description:
A path into the web app that starts with one `/` (at most 500 characters). The core makes
it an absolute link.

accepted.description: People a message was queued for.

skipped.description: People of the target who were not mailed.

SkippedReasons.description: Why people were not mailed. All five are always present.

duplicate.description: The same `dedupe_key` was accepted for them in the last 30 days.

no_address.description: The person has no verified address.

opted_out.description: The person turned this kind of mail from this plugin off.

rate_limited.description: The person already got the most plugin mail allowed in 24 hours (`mail.recipient_daily`).

post.description:
Limits: `mail.plugin_hourly_calls` accepted calls per plugin per hour and `mail.recipient_daily`
messages per person per day are `429` with `Retry-After` (for an audience the daily limit skips
the person instead); an audience of more than `mail.max_audience` people is `422` on `to` and
queues nothing.

429.description: The plugin made too many calls this hour, or the person got too much mail today. `Retry-After` says when to try again.

503.description: `[mail]` is not configured on this server

post.summary:
Sends plain-text mail in the institution's name to one person or to a course audience. The
scope `mail:send`. The mail comes from `mail.from`, ends with a footer that names the plugin and
gives a one-click opt-out per `kind`, and is sent within seconds by the mail worker, so `202`
means queued, not delivered. A person who opted out, has no verified address, has a disabled
account, already got this `dedupe_key`, or already got `mail.recipient_daily` plugin messages in
24 hours is skipped and counted in `skipped_reasons`.
